author: claude

patch.value: pm-ops fixed this on main at 15:37 on 2026-08-09 in commit 3c625b5, whose own docstring names the failure exactly: scanning .agents makes the gate depend on whether a developer happens to have extensions installed, so the same commit fails release:check locally and passes in a clean CI checkout. The fix is committed to pm-ops source and its committed dist, but v2026.08.08 was tagged before it, so the published package does not carry it. Verified by grepping the installed node_modules copy.
Adopt the canonical docstring gate, blocked on a pm-ops release carrying the .agents skip

The canonical gate is wired in and the six undocumented functions are documented, but the launcher test passes only in a clean checkout because the pinned pm-ops 2026.8.8 still scans installed extension artifacts under .agents.
npm run docstring and the launcher test pass both locally and in CI against a pinned pm-ops release that skips .agents

value.author: claude
value.text: Proved the gate passes on a clean checkout by moving the gitignored .agents/pm/extensions aside and rerunning,which reported 3 files and 52 declarations documented

value.author: claude
value.text: Held as a draft rather than merged,because a launcher test that passes in CI and fails locally is the kind of inconsistency this fleet treats as a defect

value.author: claude
value.text: A fix present in a package source tree and its committed dist is not necessarily in the published package. When a pinned dependency misbehaves check the installed copy under node_modules rather than the dependency repository
